headline: Active Combat Engages Weathered Expanse as Shifting Fronts Strain Key Sectors
war_summary: Fresh tactical clashes have flared across Weathered Expanse, where five base shifts over the last two hours have left Frostmarch and Crow's Nest fiercely contested amid nearly one thousand combined casualties. Fighting has also renewed along Stlican Shelf, registering two base changes and steady losses near Thornhold and Fort Hoarfrost. By contrast, the violent territorial exchanges reported earlier in Stonecradle and Mooring County have subsided into lull periods, with no base movements recorded in the latest two-hour window. Dead Lands remains a heavy bloodbath, sustaining over 1,600 casualties in two hours and an accelerated rate of engagement following the capture of Callahan's Gate. Nevish Line continues to see elevated attrition, logging over 1,100 casualties and 110 enlistments in two hours despite cooling trends, while Linn of Mercy exhibits an uptick in skirmish tempo after prior base contests. Outlying naval sectors including Fisherman's Row and Godcrofts remain quiet following earlier coastal actions.
